title: Video locker - Hide videos
summary: Keep your personal videos secure and private with Video Locker.
description:
Keep your videos secure and private with video Locker. video Locker is the easiest and safest way to create a secure location on your device to store and protect your personal/important videos. 

Video locker is your personal gallery where you can keep your most memorable videos and ensure that friends who use your phone don’t see your personal videos if they browse through your gallery.

Features:
- Password protected app access with a PIN / Pattern.
- Lock videos directly from your default gallery
- Works with your device’s memory / SD card to import and export videos.
- Album View to manage your videos faster.
- No storage limitations with unlimited videos.
- Multi-select feature to import hundreds of videos quickly.
- Easy unlock with just a tap.
- Does not show in ‘recent apps’ list.
- Automatically quits in device's sleep mode.
- Share locked videos directly on Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, Etc.
- You can hide your album thumbnail video
- Set cover video to your albums
- Set theme to depends on your mood

How it works:

- Enter PIN / Pattern to log-in to the app.
- Create folders right in the app to add and manage videos.
- Import / export videos from your phone / SD Card.
- Select the videos you want to lock. (Multiple selection allowed)
- Press the “Lock” icon and there! As Secure as a vault!


PASSWORD RECOVERY:
--------------------
In case if you forget your passwords we will send you to your registered e-mail id.


FAQ:
Q: Where do my videos go after I unlock them? 
A: Your videos will be at "sdcard/videolocker_UnLocked_pic" after unlocking.
Q: How can I change my password? 
A: Tap the 'Settings' icon which will show an option to change your password.
Q: Are my hidden videos stored online? 
A: No. Your videos are stored only on your device. We have no ability to remotely access your videos.
Q: Which video formats are supported by Video Locker? 
A: The app supports all major formats - .mp4 .wmv .avi .mkv .mpeg .3gp .VOB .MOV .MPEG4 .DivX


Having issues with video locker? Check out the FAQs or mail us at admin@innorriors.com.
